title: Pointwise formula for the odd part
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a bounded real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $x$ belong to that cube. The odd part of $f$ at $x$ is $(f(x)-f(-x))/2$.
